title: Book I
coreMove: Turn gratitude into a practical inventory of standards you are responsible for carrying forward.
sourcePressure: The opening ledger names relatives, teachers, governors, rulers, and gods as the sources of learned restraint, simplicity, fairness, endurance, careful reading, and freedom from display.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: gratitude as soft thankfulness or a sentimental list of influences

sourceAnchors.name: Rusticus
sourceAnchors.detail: Book I ties Rusticus to discipline, simplicity, reconciliation, careful reading, and access to Epictetus.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Rusticus matters because he makes philosophy look like disciplined conduct, not a costume.

sourceAnchors.name: Sextus
sourceAnchors.detail: Sextus is tied to benevolence, living according to nature, and gravity without affectation.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Sextus gives the standard for seriousness that does not need to harden its face.

sourceAnchors.name: Antoninus Pius
sourceAnchors.detail: Antoninus Pius is described as mild, steady, economical, careful in deliberation, anti-flattery, and free from display.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Antoninus Pius shows power with no hunger to be seen performing power.

counterintuition: what looks like control is actually surrender
the real problem is not outside you
tryThisNow: write down what you can control
examples: generic office meeting with laptop and coffee
parent-child bedtime conflict repeated across chapters

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person direct address, retrospective recognition, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

exampleSpecs.audience: new charge nurse Claire watching a senior nurse model calm correction
exampleSpecs.stakes: a medication near-miss could become blame instead of inherited standard
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Claire copies the senior nurse's exact two-question handoff after seeing it prevent a dosage error.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: The label printer spits out a crooked wristband beside the meds cart.

exampleSpecs.audience: Thomas taking over a bakery after his aunt retires
exampleSpecs.stakes: staff expect him to announce his own style by discarding hers
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Thomas keeps the aunt's quiet closing checklist and adds his own initials only after the ovens are clean.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: It took Thomas three Fridays to understand why the old checklist began with the floor drain.

exampleSpecs.audience: Emily moderating a tense philosophy seminar
exampleSpecs.stakes: students are rewarding clever interruption over careful reading
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Emily quotes no theory, pauses the room, and asks each student to name the strongest line in the text before objecting.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: "Before we answer him, what did he actually say?"

exampleSpecs.audience: Daniel inheriting a predecessor's fair but unpopular review method
exampleSpecs.stakes: a loud department head wants special treatment
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Daniel opens the prior year's scoring grid and applies it to the loudest request first.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: The council chamber clock clicks louder than the projector fan.

exampleSpecs.audience: Sophie coaching after the founder leaves
exampleSpecs.stakes: parents want quick wins over the club's old restraint standards
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: What do you keep when everyone asks for your own brand?
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Sophie benches her best player for mocking a teammate, then points to the same rule the founder used.

exampleSpecs.audience: Jack learning site inspection from a retiring architect
exampleSpecs.stakes: a cosmetic fix would hide structural sloppiness
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: You see Jack circle the same hairline crack his mentor always checked before admiring the facade.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: You are standing under scaffolding while dust falls from a limestone joint.

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'

skillTargets: apply inherited standards to a present decision
identify when humility becomes an excuse to avoid action

tryThisNowSpec: Name one trait you inherited from a real person, then write the next visible act that would honor it today.
